description: Defines the TransportParameters struct and related classes/functions for QUIC transport layer parameters, including serialization, parsing, and validation, used during TLS handshake.

classes.name: TransportParameters
classes.description: Contains QUIC transport layer parameters exchanged during TLS handshake, with methods for validation, serialization, and logging.

classes.name: TransportParameters::IntegerParameter
classes.description: Represents a variable-length integer transport parameter with validation and serialization methods.

classes.name: TransportParameters::PreferredAddress
classes.description: Holds preferred address info sent by server, including socket addresses and connection ID.

classes.name: TransportParameters::LegacyVersionInformation
classes.description: Represents Google QUIC downgrade prevention info, ported to QUIC+TLS.

classes.name: TransportParameters::VersionInformation
classes.description: Holds version info for downgrade prevention and version negotiation.

methods.name: TransportParameters::AreValid
methods.description: Validates transport parameters according to the specification.

methods.name: SerializeTransportParameters
methods.description: Serializes TransportParameters into a byte vector for TLS extension.

methods.name: ParseTransportParameters
methods.description: Parses bytes from TLS extension into TransportParameters.

methods.name: SerializeTransportParametersForTicket
methods.description: Serializes parameters and application data for early data ticket validation.

methods.name: DegreaseTransportParameters
methods.description: Removes reserved values from parameters for reliable comparison.
